description:
Starship Titanic: wander through a wayward starship full of barely-
functioning robots, solving puzzles and colleecting eleven
scattered parts to repair the ship's AI and make it back home.

v0.2.0.description:
# v0.2.0 (Unstable)
First release. I've completed a few runs with this now, so I think it's ready to be called unstable.
## Known Issues in this release
Minor cosmetic issues with items in the world sometimes
A couple edge logic issues
A softlock in the elevator I cannot reproduce for the life of me. If the LiftBot's head disappears and you're no longer able to leave the elevator, I'd love to get a save file from you

## General Tips
Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
v0.2.0.title: Starship Titanic AP v0.2.0

v0.2.1.description:
# v0.2.1 (Unstable)
Bug fix release. Both Client and .apworld updated
## Changes
- Added a missing logic rule for the Auditory Center
- Granted items with an in-world pickup location should now get put into the right spot in the viewport
- Fixed a logic issue with the Vision Center puzzle
- Fixed rendering issue with Speech Center
- Fixed an issue where the Lemon location check would be impossible if you already used the AP-granted lemon in the Bar puzzle
## Known Issues in this release
- Cosmetic issues with items in the world sometimes
- A softlock in the elevator I cannot reproduce for the life of me. If the LiftBot's head disappears and you're no longer able to leave the elevator, I'd love to get a save file from you. You can teleport out of the elevator with the Ctrl-C menu, which fixes the issue

## General Tips
- Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.
- No visual tracker yet, but for now I highly recommend Universal Tracker to see in-logic checks

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
v0.2.1.title: Starship Titanic AP v0.2.1

v0.2.6.description:
# v0.2.6 (Unstable) - Client Only Update
Update for client only. .apworld is unchanged. Compatible with existing seeds back to v0.2.2
## Fixes
- The 2nd class upgrade check would eat the Magazine item and make the check impossible if you attempted it before receiving a stateroom from the multiworld
- The 1st class upgrade check was only possible if you were exactly 2nd class. Once you received 1st class from the multiworld, the check was impossible
- Receiving a progressive class upgrade item while your class level was being spoofed would cause the item to be lost
- Saving while your class level was spoofed could write the spoofed class level to the save file, making it permanent
- Loading a save now resyncs your class level and staterooms from the server
## Changes
- None
## Known Issues in this release
- Cosmetic issues with items in the world sometimes

## General Tips
- Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.
- No visual tracker yet, but for now I highly recommend Universal Tracker to see in-logic checks

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)

v0.3.2.description:
# v0.3.2 (Unstable)
Both client and .apworld updated. Make sure to regenerate your YAML templates to see the new options.
## New Features
- Major feature: Optional Access Cards for each area of the ship
- New Client UI Panel for tracking acquired Access Cards
- Deliverable Item Reminders: Approaching a Succ-u-Bus terminal that has already been checked will give an in-game reminder of how many AP items are waiting to be delivered. 
## Fixes
- A rare situation could trap the player in the embarkation lobby early in a seed
- Checks collected while offline were not being sent properly when the client reconnects
- Lemon would not be interactable if it was granted and used in the Vision center puzzle before being picked up naturally
## Changes
- Added a safety net that will return the Magazine to the player if the 2nd Class upgrade check fails
## Known Issues in this release
- Minor cosmetic issues with both Ear puzzles

## General Tips
- Ctrl+C opens the cheat menu, which allows teleporting around the ship. This shouldn't cause any major issues, but I would be careful spawning items, because that may get messy.
- No visual tracker yet, but for now I highly recommend Universal Tracker to see in-logic checks

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
v0.3.2.title: Starship Titanic AP v0.3.2

v0.4.0.description:
# v0.4.0 (Unstable)
Both client and .apworld updated. Incompatible with older seeds.
Make sure to regenerate your YAML templates to see the new goal options.
## New Features
- New Goal Option: Repair Titania
  - Goal completed the moment you correctly add the last piece to Titania. Saves a few minutes of cutscenes compared to the Return Home goal
- Improved information panel on the client showing room accessibility and checks remaining
- More client commands. Changed prefix to / instead of ! for clarity. Usable in-game or in the client window:
  - /help - list all client commands
  - /ap \<text\> - sends \<text\> to the AP server from in game
  - /hint - alias for /ap !hint. Used the same way as AP's !hint command
  - /force_seed - Forces the client to accept the current save as the correct save for the connected slot
  - /return \<item\> - [experimental] Returns an item to your inventory. Only works with items already received from the multiworld. Recommended only as a bug recovery tool
  - /getmail - [experimental] Moves all the pending granted AP items from the mail system straight into your inventory. Skip listening to the Succ-U-Bus vomiting sounds! (after 170 hours of testing, I am overjoyed)
  - /loc - prints your current location data
## Changes
- Client log now uses the standard AP colors when reporting checks and items
- Changed client command prefix to / to avoid confusion with !-prefixed AP commands
## Fixes
- Crushed TV location check would permanently fail if you held it on your cursor for too long after you picked it up
- Added missing Parrot Lobby access rule to Crushed TV check
- Titania's Nose could be invisible and non-interactive in some situations
- Titania's Core would sometimes render invisibly inside the parrot cage
- The save/seed tagging system would only tag the save game with the AP seed, which could cause issues if there were multiple Starship Titanic slots in the room. Now it uses the seed and the slot name
## Known Issues in this release
- Cosmetic issues with both Ear puzzles
- Sometimes you can take the Phonograph ear before you've finished the Music Room puzzle
- Traps are generated as filler items but their effects are not implemented yet

## General Tips
- I highly recommend Universal Tracker to see in-logic checks

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
v0.4.0.title: Starship Titanic AP v0.4.0
